title: ci(ui-merge): Test UI runs only the ui tests a pull request or merge group affects — the root ci.yml wires ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao47d4XTXUAPA2geTEJykbxK)_

Fixes #25868
Part of #25677

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** 根 `ci.yml` 的 Test UI(16 个分片)在 pull request 和 merge queue 上不再每次跑全量 ui 测试，而是先用 objectui 原有的 `ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs` 选出本次改动影响到的测试文件，只跑这些。push 到 main、每小时的 schedule 和手动触发仍然跑全量。
- **为什么改:** 合并后每个 ui PR 都跑 16 个全量分片(每片 7–14 分钟，约 190 runner-min)。在 objectui 仓库时，小 PR 只跑受影响的测试，CI 3–8 分钟。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 选择器漏掉的测试，要等 main 上的全量运行(每小时一次)才会发现，这是 objectui 原来就接受的取舍。选择器出错、拿不到 diff 基点时一律回退到全量，不会跳过。ui/ 之外影响所有 ui 测试的改动(根目录的 lockfile、workspace、turbo.json 等非文档文件，`patches/`，以及 ui 测试读取其构建产物的 7 个 @objectstack 包)一律全量。回滚：revert 本 PR 即恢复每次全量。
- **席位意见:**
- **你要做的:** 这是 Tier H(改了 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`)，需要你批准后由席位落地。

## What changed

1. **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, job `test-ui`** — objectui's two-step wiring, ported:
   - `Select the tests this change affects` (id `select`): `pull_request` and `merge_group` run the selector; every other event writes `mode=full`. Fails open: no base, a non-zero exit or no verdict line means `mode=full`, never a skip. The exit status is captured beside the output, not through a command substitution.
   - The PR diff base is `merge-base(origin/BASE_REF, HEAD)`, the same base Test Core uses, not the payload's frozen `base.sha`. With the frozen sha, every commit `main` gained while the PR was open (a lockfile bump among them) would be charged to the PR and turn it into a full run. A merge group diffs from `merge_group.base_sha`.
   - `Run the ui tests (shard N/16)` reads the output's VALUE (`affected` / `full`). On `affected` it runs `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --shard=N/16 ... FILTERS` with the filters relative to `ui/` (the vitest root), as positionals with no separator, which is the only form `ui/scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` accepts. On `full` it runs the command it ran before.
   - The checkout takes `fetch-depth: 0` so the base's history is there (Test Core and Type Check UI do the same).
2. **`ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs`** — the git paths already went through `--relative` (#25728). Its own diff dropped every changed file outside `ui/`, though, so a lockfile bump, a root `tsconfig.json` or a `packages/spec` change selected only the always-on set (measured below). New: `changedOutsideTree()` lists the monorepo's own changes (git at the workspace root, `--relative` again, the `ui/` prefix dropped), and `outsideTreeReasons()` turns them into full-run reasons:
   - a workspace-root file that is not documentation, or anything under `patches/` (the rule the selector already applied to objectui's own root, now applied to the root this tree installs from);
   - a file in a monorepo package that a ui package depends on (any field), or that such a package depends on at run time (`dependencies` / `peerDependencies` / `optionalDependencies`). On this tree that set is exactly the seven packages the `ui_consumers` filter names: spec, client, core, types, lint, formula, sdui-parser.
   - Everything else outside `ui/` (other packages, docs, `.changeset/`, `.github/`, `scripts/`) reaches ui tests only through the always-on set, as before.
3. **`ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts`** now reads the root `ci.yml` (located through `workspaceRoot()`) and runs both steps there at the monorepo root. A `git` stand-in answers `merge-base` as HEAD and records the call, so the legs assert the step asks for `refs/remotes/origin/main` and `HEAD`. A new leg covers a failing merge-base: full run. The controls are unchanged.
4. **`ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts`**: the `ci.yml` wiring block now reads the root job (including `fetch-depth: 0` and the 16-wide matrix). A new nested-layout fixture (`ui/` under a parent workspace) covers each outside-tree rule in both directions. One case runs real git in a scratch repo to show that `changedFiles` and `changedOutsideTree` split one diff between them.

The turbo parity case (`agrees with turbo on who depends on whom`) was already green in the merged layout on `main`. It is unchanged and still green.

`ui/.github/workflows/ci.yml` (objectui's copy, which runs nowhere) is left as it is; the governance-workflow audit owns it.

## Measured

Selector verdicts on this tree (`c475b45b` + this diff), from scratch commits in a detached worktree:

| change | verdict | selected test files |
|---|---|---|
| nothing under `ui/` (this PR's own shape: workflow + `ui/scripts`) | affected | 686 of 5810 |
| one leaf, `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/index.ts` | affected | 1036 of 5810 |
| `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanColumnSummary.ts` (reaches app-shell) | affected | 2647 of 5810 |
| `pnpm-lock.yaml` + `packages/spec/src/index.ts`, before this diff | affected | 686 of 5810 (the hole) |
| the same, after | full | — |

Weighted by `ui/scripts/test-shard-timings.json` (the sequencer's per-file dataset): always-on alone is 8.8% of the summed file time, plugin-gantt 20.2%, plugin-kanban 54.2%, `ui/packages/fields` 88.9%. Each shard still pays its fixed cost (checkout, install, building the seven packages). The before/after shard wall times are read from this PR's own Test UI run, which is the always-on shape, and posted on the card.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests.test.ts scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts` (in `ui/`): 2 files, 49 tests, all pass.
- Whole `ui/scripts/__tests__` suite (`pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__` in `ui/`, head `bc79c8aa`): 190 files, 5608 passed, 2 skipped, 1 failed. The failure is `check-pre-install-import-graph.test.ts` > "finds no pre-install gate reaching a package" (`unresolved: scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs`, which the cutover deleted and `ui/.github/workflows/*` still name). It fails the same way on `c475b45b` with this diff's four files restored (37 tests, 1 failed), so it is red on `main` already and not this PR's. It is reported to the dispatcher. That file is in the always-on set, so it keeps running on every affected Test UI run.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --ran`: 63 derived, 59 run with exit 0, 4 NOT MEASURED (exit 3, built dists absent): `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. These are Build Core's guards, and Build Core runs them on this PR (`ci.yml` is in the `core` filter).

## Acceptance notes

- A spec-only PR still runs no Test UI (the `ui` filter decides that, unchanged). On a merge group, Test UI runs today for every entry, and this diff makes it full for an entry that touches the seven packages or a root install input, and affected otherwise. #25867 (merge_group ui path diff) is the card that decides whether such an entry runs Test UI at all.
- Vitest import overhead (card's optional note): not measured here.
